name: Hogar y Camping
description: Uruguayan online store selling camping, fishing, archery, cutlery, home and garden products. It delivers in Montevideo by its own courier and to the rest of Uruguay through DAC, and offers pickup at its Montevideo store.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de camping, pesca, arquería, cuchillería, hogar y jardín. Entrega en Montevideo con courier propio y al interior por DAC; ofrece retiro en su local de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo by own courier at a flat rate; rest of Uruguay dispatched free by the store, DAC fee paid on receipt

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the store in Sayago, Montevideo, weekdays and Saturday morning; buyer is notified by email when the order is ready

shopping_notes: WooCommerce store with cart. Prices appear with a plain $ sign; the probe also saw USD prices.

sources.supports: shipping: Montevideo courier, DAC to the interior, pickup
